_comment: Godot-only content: the guided first day (steps shown one at a time by the guide card) and one-time tip cards. {action} is replaced by the player's current key for that action; {move} by the four movement keys. done: moved | looked | flag:X | panel:X | buildmode | accepted:Q | ready:Q | quest:Q | objective:Q:index | stage:Q:N (request Q has reached its Nth stage, counting from 0). reveal: HUD parts that appear from this step on.

steps.text: Walk with {move}. The Sindaco is waiting at the village gate, waving. He has been waving for some time. Go and say hello.
Look around: drag with the right mouse button, or press {cam_left} / {cam_right}. Scroll to zoom. The Sindaco would like you to admire the view.
Walk up to the Sindaco and press {interact} to talk. He has prepared remarks.
Find a tree with a pink ribbon (the compass points to the nearest) and press {interact} to chop. Press {interact} again when the needle is in the green.
Press {inventory} to open your bag and see what you gathered.
Find the Sindaco's reading glasses: lost things glint on the ground. Just walk over them.
Go back to the Sindaco and press {interact} to give him his glasses.
Press {journal} to open your journal. Every request you take on is kept there. The Sindaco says he keeps a copy.
The storm washed out the main road, and Aldo's bus is stuck at the lay-by by the village gate. Find him by his bus and press {interact}.
Aldo needs 10 more wood for the crossing. Chop ribboned trees; the request card in the corner counts for you.
You have the wood! Walk to the washout and press {build} to open your Geometra's kit.
Lay planks from bank to bank. A plank must be within 2 tiles of a bank or a post.
Aldo asked for railings: place 4 along the sides of the crossing. A railing sits on a tile's edge; {rotate} turns it.
Tell Aldo the crossing is open!

talk.title: Talking
lines: Click an answer, or press its number.
Gold answers start a request.
Goodbye is always 0 (or Esc).

chop.title: Chopping
lines: Press {interact} when the needle is in the green. Gold is a perfect swing.
Three swings fell the tree. It grows back after a while.

mine.title: Mining
lines: Press {interact} when the dark ring lines up with the green circle.
Rusty-red rocks hold extra metal.

fish.title: Fishing
lines: Wait for the bobber to dip, then press {interact}.
Keep the fish inside the green bar to reel it in.

build.title: How building works
lines: Pick a piece below and click to build; {rotate} turns it. Red says why it won't fit.
Purple outlines are a plan: put the same piece on each. {plan_next} picks up the next one.
Ctrl+Z undoes. Esc leaves.

harmony.title: The Sindaco's approval rating
lines: Helping villagers and building things raise the Sindaco's approval rating. He takes the credit; you get the rewards.
New plans, places and surprises unlock as it grows. Press {progress} to see what's next.

journal.title: Your journal
lines: Active requests, finished ones, and what's still to do.
Track a request to point the compass at it.

map.title: The map
lines: Monteforchetta is only the beginning.
Once the bus line to the city runs, other places open up.

requests.title: More villagers need you
lines: An orange ! above someone means they have a request. A green ★ means a request is ready to hand in.
Take them in any order. There's no rush.
